# Lab 3.5: Legacy Streaming Inserts vs Write API

## What We Are Going to Do
Stream rows with the legacy `insertAll` API, look at the streaming buffer, and see why DML on fresh rows fails.

## Steps

   It fails: **"would affect rows in the streaming buffer, which is not supported"**. Wait up to about 90 minutes and it works.

5. **[Console] Compare costs.** Open the **Pricing** page from the BigQuery docs and compare legacy streaming inserts with the Storage Write API. The Write API is cheaper and includes free monthly volume.

## Expected Result

| Thing | Reality |
|---|---|
| insertAll | Works, best-effort dedup |
| Streaming buffer | Shown in table metadata |
| DML on fresh rows | Blocked while rows are in the buffer |
| Recommendation | Use the Storage Write API for new work |
